Thoradin's Wall is a huge wall separating the Arathi Highlands from Hillsbrad Foothills. The wall may have protected Stromgarde and the Arathi Highlands from the invading Scourge, but this was not its original purpose, the wall having existed for many centuries prior to the Third War. In World of Warcraft, the gigantic wall is heavily damaged. In the Escape from Durnholde Keep instance of the Caverns of Time, the wall is in considerably better condition, but still quite a bit damaged.

The Thondroril River forms a natural boundary between the Western and Eastern Plaguelands. The spring of this river is located in the current closed area known as Northern Lordaeron and runs from near the Terrorweb Tunnel to the north and empties out into Darrowmere Lake to the south. South of the lake it becomes the Darrowmere River. Along the river on on both sides, you can find maggots, vampire bats, plaguebears, spiders and later snapjaws. Prior to Cataclysm, Tirion Fordring (a level 61 elite quest giver) was found near a ruined farmhouse on the Eastern Plaguelands side of the river.

Thistleshrub Valley is an area thick with giant cacti (which are very unusually alive for Tanaris) and was also thick with desert-dwelling thistleshrubs until recently. Desert Blooms can now be found here, but only sparsely. Budd's gang can be found in Thistleshrub Valley getting ready to lead the caravan into Uldum. Adarrah offers a quest, with a minimum level of 84. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the area falls under the Legion's control.

Thistlefur Village is a village located in the westcentral area of Ashenvale, north of Astranaar. It is the homeland of the Thistlefur tribe of corrupted furbolgs, who aggressively attack anyone who wanders too close. The Thistlefur tribe is led by two extremely ferocious warriors: Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl.

]] Thistlefur Hold is located in west-central Ashenvale, in the northern part of Thistlefur Village. It is home to the bulk of the Thistlefur furbolgs, and contains two quests for Horde characters — collecting troll charms and rescuing Ruul Snowhoof, who is trapped in a cage deep in the hold. The furbolgs here also held the Idol of Remulos for a time, which is what corrupted them and turned them hostile to all outsiders.
Thistle Bears are brown bears found in Darkshore. They are less fierce than Grizzled Thistle Bears and not diseased like the Rabid Thistle Bears.

Tholo and Anren were first seen at Nordrassil, where the tauren tasked an adventurer to feed the local faerie dragons in order to reveal hidden Twilight Hammer inciters. In order to halt the enemies, the druids found their camp and Tholo had the adventurer use his horn to summon a Emerald Flameweaver and incinerate the encampment. The duo later traveled to the Sanctuary of Malorne and joined the efforts at the Regrowth against the fire elementals of Ragnaros. They were assisted by adventurers sent by Matoclaw. The Thistleleaf sprites are a group of sprites located in Val'sharah. They cause problems for the locals by capturing and killing faerie dragons and putting Druids of the Fin to sleep in shark-infested waters. They have been baiting unwary travelers into their groves, by placing what appears to be unguarded treasure right out in the open. When they are bored they ensnare their victims to continue their torment later. Saylanna Riverbreeze speculated that their thorndancers manipulated the other sprites.

Threat is a measure of an NPC's aggression towards a player. Each NPC has a threat table, and a unit toward the top of the list is usually the target of its aggression. In-game, this is known as having aggro from that particular NPC. The NPC will attack that character if possible, unless something overrides the NPC's target.

Thousand Needles (aka The Thousand Needles) is a huge dry canyon in Southern Kalimdor, filled with towering mesas. In the east, the canyon opens up to the Shimmering Flats, a vast salt pan that is used by Goblin and Gnomish engineers for their races. Despite being relatively barren, the area has its own harsh beauty, and the sunrise seen from either Freewind Post or one of the mesas around Darkcloud Pinnacle can be spectacular. The Shimmering Flats and Mirage Raceway are also worth visiting for their surreal, lonely atmosphere. Although as a contested territory this area doesn't see anywhere near as much action as some, Darkcloud Pinnacle is a favorite stealth ganking spot for Alliance rogue

The Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is a group of Dark Iron dwarves who are not members of the Dark Iron clan. On the cliffs overlooking the region called the Cauldron, in the far north of the Searing Gorge, the dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood have established a base of operations, Thorium Point. From here, they keep a close eye on the Dark Iron dwarves' activities in the Searing Gorge and beyond. Adventurers seeking out Thorium Point will find that the dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood hold great rewards for those who aid them in their never ending struggle against their former brethren. An ingredient for most Tailoring recipes and many Leatherworking recipes. All thread is vendor-bought. Higher level recipes will move on to more expensive threads, usually coinciding with the cloth or leather that you're using, although that's only a rough guide. *Coarse Thread costs from vendors and is used in low-skill Tailoring and Leatherworking combinations. Its generally seen alongside Linen and Light Leather. *Fine Thread costs from vendors and follows after Coarse thread. Its usually used with Wool, Silk, Medium Leather, and Heavy Leather. *Silken Thread costs and usually works with Mageweave and Heavy Leather. *Heavy Silken Thread costs and works alongside Mageweave and Thick Leathe

Thornby and Garth were villagers who offered to aid Prince Arthas Menethil in battle when the he passed through their village, located between a Silver Hand encampment and the town of Strahnbrad. Arming themselves as footmen, they helped Prince Arthas fight against the Blackrock Clan, gnolls and the Bloodhill Bandits.

This is a grenade. Stronger than Iron Grenades and throwable while running.
The Thorium Shield Spike is an enhancement for a shield. Any time the user blocks an attack, the shield spike does some damage to the attacker.
Threat of the Winterfall is the 2nd quest in the Trouble in Winterspring! quest chain.

Thrallmar is a Horde town found in Hellfire Peninsula (), Outland. It was founded and now led by Nazgrel, commander of Thrall's security, as an opportunity to gain resources and to have a decent control over what's going on in this demon-infested area. The residents of the town form a faction of its own; reputation is raised by performing quests for them. These quests generally involve killing fel orcs in Hellfire Citadel. The town is made up of a barracks, a kennel, an inn and an alchemy tower.
Thrag Stonehoof is a tauren located at Karn's Smithy on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff.

Mobs have threat lists, also known as hate lists. This is a list of all the characters that have angered the mob, ordered from the one with the largest amount of threat down to the least. Generally speaking, if a mob kills the player with the most threat (at the top of the list), it will then move to attack the next on the list. The person the mob attacks is the person with aggro. Though in theory we would say that the player with the most threat will also have aggro, in practice it is a bit more fuzzy. In groups, the actions each player takes with respect to the mob will move them up or down the threat list. However, the other members of the group are also moving up or down the threat list,

Thork is an orc quest giver located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He leads the defenses in the area. Before the Cataclysm, Mankrik asked him for help but he turned him down. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town. Thork alongside Sergra Darkthorn attended the first Azerothian Kosh'harg held in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Thrashtail Basilisks are basilisks found in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Thorngrin the Tender is the third boss of the Botanica wing of the Tempest Keep instance in Netherstorm.
Thornfang Hill is a nesting ground for ravagers in Hellfire Peninsula. It is the pathway from Hellfire to Zangarmarsh; the Cenarion Refuge sits right on the edge of Zangarmarsh near this area.

Thrallmar Mine is a gan'arg-infested mine underneath Thrallmar. Cleaning up in the mine is part of a short quest chain. Despite its proximity to Thrallmar, the goblin foreman of the mine is friendly to both Alliance and Horde and gives quests to both sides.
The Thoriumweave Cloak drops from Mechano-Lord Capacitus in The Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
The Thrallmar Tabard is a mark of honor amongst the Thrallmar faction and is only available to Thrallmar's most trusted allies.
Thornstone Sledgehammer is a world drop from level 36 - 45 mobs.
Thornroot Club is a quest reward from Ursal the Mauler (quest).

Thorson's Post is a farm on the northeastern edge of the Carrion Fields in the Dragonblight. Duke August Foehammer, originally stationed at Ahn'Qiraj for its accompanying world event, is now based here for the quest Steamtank Surprise.
Thoth is a draenei inscription trainer who can be found in the Crystal Hall in the Exodar.

The Threads of Fate is a clothing shop found in Dalaran. It used to be next to the Wonderworks. In the Legion version of Dalaran, it has been moved to where the Sisters Sorcerous was, and the art gallery named Photonic Playground took its place.

Thrall's Vision is the opening cinematic of the Exodus of the Horde campaign. Thrall, warchief of the Horde, was contacted by the Prophet in his dreams.

Thorium Gearshafts are looted from War Reaver Parts after defeating War Reavers in the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes.
The Thousand-Thread-Count Fuse is found aboard the Fortune's Fist off the coast of the Swamp of Sorrows.
Thorny Stankroots are located in the Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands.

The Thornsnarl is an area in southern Mulgore where Fledgling Braves fight against Bristleback Invaders seeking to claim new land from the tauren. Other quilboar inhabitants include Bristleback Gun Thieves, Bristleback Thorncallers and Young Battleboars. Captured Braves can be found in the northern portion of this subzone and are rescued as part of a tauren starting quest. As a result of the Cataclysm, there is a lake in the southern part of this area. However, it is not included in any subzone.

Thornmantle's Hideout is a small enclave in the southwestern corner of Mulgore. The ground is covered with vines, and the quilboar have grown massive thorns so that the area resembles a cave. It is inhabited by the leader of the Bristleback tribe, Chief Squealer Thornmantle, and two Thornguards. They are surrounded by the burning corpses of tauren braves that have fallen against them.
The Thornweaver Leggings item is a quest reward from The Far Watch Offensive.
Thorned Necklace is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Vrykul Archaeology Fragments to solve, and allows use of two keystones.

Thrall's Encampment was a small encampment southwest of Durnholde Keep, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. It consisted only of Thrall's hut, which was a unselectable barracks. An orcish encampment, seemingly of Blackrock origin, was nearby. It is here he was first visited by The Prophet, also known as Medivh.
Thornwood Staff drops from Mannoroth and Varo'then in the Well of Eternity.

Three-Tooth is what the Bristleback quilboar call their matriarch. She's been twisting the thorns of this crazy jungle to her own ends, and it was her orders that Ambassador Gaines be "torn apart and fed to the overgrowth." Corporal Teegan orders to kill her and the Deviate Crones she's been training, to ensure nobody else can take her place. Using a Bramblestaff on her summons a Merciless Jungle Vine that grabs and squishes her.
Thorn Eater Ghouls are ghouls found in the Murder Pens in Razorfen Downs.
